import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 510;
    static long[][] C = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[] F = new long[MAXN];
    static long[] G = new long[MAXN];
    static long[][] DP = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] WAYS = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] DP0 = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] WAYS0 = new long[MAXN][MAXN];

    static void add_mod(long[] x, long y, int mod) {
        // Not used directly; we use a method that modifies a long reference? In Java, we pass array element.
    }

    static long comb2(long x, int mod) {
        return ((x * (x - 1)) / 2) % mod;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int mod = sc.nextInt();
        sc.close();

        // Initialize combinations C[n][k]
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            C[i][0] = 1;
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                C[i][j] = (C[i-1][j-1] + C[i-1][j]) % mod;
            }
        }

        // Compute F and G arrays up to m
        F[0] = 0; G[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                long term1 = (C[i-1][j-1] * F[j-1]) % mod;
                term1 = (term1 * G[i-j]) % mod;
                term1 = (term1 * (i+1)) % mod;
                long term2 = (C[i-1][j-1] * G[j-1]) % mod;
                term2 = (term2 * F[i-j]) % mod;
                term2 = (term2 * (i+1)) % mod;
                long term3 = (C[i-1][j-1] * G[j-1]) % mod;
                term3 = (term3 * G[i-j]) % mod;
                long comb = (comb2(j, mod) + comb2(i-j+1, mod)) % mod;
                term3 = (term3 * comb) % mod;
                F[i] = (F[i] + term1 + term2 + term3) % mod;
                long gterm = (C[i-1][j-1] * G[j-1]) % mod;
                gterm = (gterm * G[i-j]) % mod;
                gterm = (gterm * (i+1)) % mod;
                G[i] = (G[i] + gterm) % mod;
            }
        }

        // Initialize DP and WAYS
        DP[0][0] = 0;
        WAYS[0][0] = 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            long[][] DP2 = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
            long[][] WAYS2 = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
            for (int j = 0; j <= Math.min(i, m); j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k <= Math.min(j, m); k++) {
                    if (k == 0) {
                        DP0[i][j] = DP[j][0];
                        WAYS0[i][j] = WAYS[j][0];
                    }
                    // add DP2[j][0] and WAYS2[j][0]
                    DP2[j][0] = (DP2[j][0] + DP[j][k]) % mod;
                    WAYS2[j][0] = (WAYS2[j][0] + WAYS[j][k]) % mod;

                    int rem = m - (j - k);
                    // update WAYS2[j+1][k+1]
                    long w = (WAYS0[i-k][j-k] * C[rem][k+1]) % mod;
                    w = (w * G[k+1]) % mod;
                    WAYS2[j+1][k+1] = (WAYS2[j+1][k+1] + w) % mod;
                    // update DP2[j+1][k+1]
                    long d = (DP0[i-k][j-k] * C[rem][k+1]) % mod;
                    d = (d * G[k+1]) % mod;
                    long d2 = (WAYS0[i-k][j-k] * C[rem][k+1]) % mod;
                    d2 = (d2 * F[k+1]) % mod;
                    DP2[j+1][k+1] = (DP2[j+1][k+1] + d + d2) % mod;
                }
            }
            // Copy DP2 to DP and WAYS2 to WAYS
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXN; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < MAXN; k++) {
                    DP[j][k] = DP2[j][k];
                    WAYS[j][k] = WAYS2[j][k];
                }
            }
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
            ans = (ans + DP[m][i]) % mod;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
